requirement.description: The receive_messages method in SubprocessCLITransport is not correctly implementing the AsyncIterator protocol. Tests fail with "'async for' requires an object with __aiter__ method, got coroutine" which indicates that when this method is called from ClaudeSDKClient.receive_messages(), it doesn't properly return an AsyncIterator.
requirement.contract: The receive_messages method must return a proper AsyncIterator[dict[str, Any]] that can be consumed by async for loops. It should correctly iterate over the stdout stream and yield parsed JSON messages without throwing TypeError about missing __aiter__ method.

requirement.description: The query method in ClaudeSDKClient has incorrect handling of AsyncIterable prompts. When a streaming prompt (AsyncIterable) is provided, the method should properly iterate over all messages and send them to the transport, but the current implementation may not be handling the async iteration correctly.
requirement.contract: The query method should accept either a string or an AsyncIterable[dict[str, Any]] and properly forward all messages from the async iterable to the transport's send_request method with proper session_id handling.
